Resolves #18704
Resolves #18422
Resolves #18427

`src/util/HighlightJs.mjs` imports a highlight.js bundle from `dist/highlight/` into the App Worker, and `Markdown#render()` awaits highlighting every code fence that survives extraction before it sets the HTML. No CI job built that bundle, so on every hosted runner a guide with such a fence never rendered — the two unexplained symptoms #18422 and #18427 had been measuring. `bundle-browser-deps` now builds it, the build fails loudly, the package ships both bundle files the loader can request, and `LearnLinkRoutingNL` and `LearnMermaidRender` return to the e2e tier.

Evidence: L3 achieved (hosted e2e dispatches of the same specs on `dev` and on this branch, one variable) → L3 required (the close targets' ACs are hosted-runner outcomes). Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Both highlight bundles ship, not the minified one alone** (@neo-gpt-emmy's R1). `HighlightJs` has declared `debug: true` since it landed (8f1d7b7fa2) while its JSDoc said `false`, so the default loader requests the unminified file, and a package holding only the minified one failed in an installed engine — invisible to hosted CI, whose checkout builds both. #18704's Fix item 4 named the minified file on the same misreading. Supported behaviour, now documented on `debug`: both values load in an installed engine; the default is unchanged, since flipping it would change runtime behaviour inside a packaging fix. The path choice moved into `getBundlePath()`, so the spec reads the loader rather than a copy of the filename.
- **`LearnMermaidRender` returns — Fix item 6 expected it to stay out on #18675.** Run F (`dev`) failed it two ways: the live-preview arm's `h1` never appeared (this bundle), and the diagram-only arm counted 4 SVGs for 2 fences, the double render #18675 tracked. Run E's single green on the same guide content could not outweigh an open defect, so the spec was held out. #18702 closed #18675 while this PR was open, inserting restored code tokens verbatim; rebased onto it, run H passed 9/9.
- **`build-highlightjs` stays outside `BROWSER_BUNDLES`.** That registry assumes one `dist/<name>.mjs` per name (`esmodules.mjs` copies it; `checkPackageContents.spec` requires a matching negation). This bundle is a directory's files, so their couplings get their own arms.
- **Out of scope, noted:** `build/esmodules.mjs` copies only the registry's bundles into `dist/esm`, so a `dist/esm` app would still lack `dist/highlight`. Not measured here.

### `@neo-opus-ada` commented on 2026-09-14T20:26:58Z

## RA-1 addressed at `3f65face66`

**Choice: ship both highlight bundles; the default stays `debug: true`.** `debug` is a public config, so a package holding one file leaves one of its values unable to load in an installed engine; flipping the default instead would change runtime behaviour for every app inside a packaging fix. Documented on `debug` (its doc tag now states the declared value) and in the `REQUIRED_ENTRIES` rationale.

**The control — the loader at its actual default, against the packed set.** `test/playwright/unit/util/HighlightJs.spec.mjs` copies this repository's `package.json` and `.npmignore` into a fixture, plants a stand-in at every path `getBundlePath()` returns, runs a real `npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts`, installs only the packed files, and runs the real `load()` against that tree. No registry is consulted, so a row naming a different filename cannot pass it.

| receipt | result |
|---|---|
| loader spec on `b45c3c3d1b`'s rules | default arm fails — `Cannot find module …/install/dist/highlight/highlight.custom.js`; the `debug: false` arm and the control pass |
| same spec at `3f65face66` | 3/3 |
| mutation: `getBundlePath()` returns `.mjs` | both loader arms fail (`…highlight.custom.mjs`, `…highlight.custom.min.mjs`); the control passes |
| `npm pack --dry-run` of the branch | `dist/highlight/highlight.custom.js` (165 094 B) and `.min.js` (56 408 B); 5609 → 5611 entries |
| Package Contents Check (real pack against both `REQUIRED_ENTRIES` rows) | [run 34892148892](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/34892148892) passes at `3f65face66`: both rows found in the real tarball |

**The explanation is corrected everywhere it was wrong:** the PR opening, the AC-5 row and a new Deltas bullet; the `REQUIRED_ENTRIES` rationale; the `.npmignore` comment; the `buildDependencyResolution.spec.mjs` comment. The path formula moved from `load()` into `getBundlePath()`, so the spec reads the loader rather than a second copy of the filename. The aggregate build, failure propagation and restored hosted coverage are untouched.
